rules: The delegation contract digest and run identity must match on every command, event, interaction, and result.
Retries reuse the same idempotency key and cannot create a second run.
Cancellation races are resolved by aggregate expected_version; a terminal run returns its existing result rather than reopening.
Expired or revoked authority cannot dispatch, resume, amend, resolve, publish, or cancel except through separately authorized reconciliation.
Purpose changes require an append-only Telos amendment and a controller contract.amend command; mutable ambient goal text is not authority.
Controller results report evidence but never mutate Telos sub-goal status directly.
